mapper.sql: id, order_id, order_no, user_id, pay_amount, pay_type, pay_status, trade_no, notify_id, pay_time, refund_time, version, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record ( id, order_id, order_no, user_id, pay_amount, pay_type, pay_status, trade_no, notify_id, pay_time, refund_time, version, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{payAmount}, #{payType}, #{payStatus}, #{tradeNo}, #{notifyId}, #{payTime}, #{refundTime}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0), COALESCE(#{isDeleted}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND pay_type = #{payType} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM payment_record WHERE notify_id = #{notifyId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM payment_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
